_comment: Where loop limits come from, across every slt/sltu in the resident EXE. Regenerate: tools/phase4_loop_limit_origins.py

register_form_was_a_real_blind_spot.note: The register form was 43% of all comparisons and invisible to the affine pass. It is now handled -- correctly, and to zero measured effect.

verdict: NOT VIABLE as a general basis. Only 8 of 1191 loop limits (0.7%) are literals; 324 (27%) are LOADED from memory and 859 (72%) cannot be pinned. In this image element counts come from DATA -- chunk headers, save state, config -- not from constants in the instruction stream, so reading fill loops cannot recover object extents at scale. The two successes (_SsVmInit's 32, the weld table's mod-100) are the exceptions, not the rule.
